$comment: Remove-project requests (`doan remove`) on the app's local socket, beside app-socket.v1 (active), v2 (onboarding), v3 (work), v4 (open), v5 (handoff) and v6 (prototype), which are unchanged. A separate v: an older app answers v7 with its v1 bad_request, which the CLI reads as app_protocol_mismatch. The reader dispatches on numeric v before validating. Use the $defs; the root constrains nothing. The reply says what the app decided, not what the CLI prints: the CLI builds its own messages and next steps from the code, except busy, whose app message names what blocks.

token.$comment: Not pattern-checked so a wrong token reaches the app's bad_token answer instead of bad_request.

absolutePath.$comment: Absolute POSIX path; the app is macOS-only.

root.$comment: The root the CLI discovered; the app compares it with its registered roots as a string and removes that root's whole project group.

errorCode.$comment: In the app's check order after the schema and token: project_not_open (the root is not registered, or the removal found nothing to remove), busy (still loading, first run or the buddy screen, a dialog, a locked page), conversation_running (a turn of any conversation in the group's roots is running, including one waiting on a permission request or a question). Every refusal changes nothing.

project.$comment: The group's name as the sidebar shows it: the main worktree's folder name.

roots.$comment: Every registered root of the group that left the list, absolute, in stored order.
